rationale.conceptual: The task implements an established but non-trivial Landauer-based TBC prediction method with a local nonequilibrium correction, combined with DFT phonon calculations. It requires understanding of phonon transport theory, the diffuse mismatch model, and careful numerical integration over Brillouin zone data; not a simple textbook recipe.
rationale.execution: The workflow comprises multiple stages: DFT relaxation and force constant calculation for four materials, phonon post-processing with Phonopy, and a separate Landauer code; it involves handling external tools, file I/O, and ensuring consistency across steps.
